# Native clump retirement and remaining behavior frontier

The native `272EC0` owner walks the real clump's perception groups and actors,
unlinks both intrusive perception memberships, clears matching actor and unit
attachment references, and reclaims the original data-array records. Its
direct semantic closure includes `274800`, `2731E0`, `16E8A0`, `2748E0`,
`274970`, `1EA400` before callback dispatch, and `299AA0`.

`1EA400` also calls the actor's real behavior descriptor `+28` callback at
`1EA562`. A separate typed module closes all four nonzero callbacks in the
original behavior kinds27/21/56/124: `1BDA70`, `1C8E90`, `1C75B0`, and `1C9750`. They
clear matching behavior fields and the actual plan record's reference; they
do not supply an invented successful return. The production boundary invokes
that native module. Unknown selectors fail at their actual frontier. The
typed request contains callback identity, actor, behavior record and removed
perception reference. No instruction machine or original runtime code is used.

The reference fixture executes unchanged English Xbox TU1.5 code, SHA256
`21b207e7efdacaf6124a0822837f8be570766a42505057f7fd2d2ba8f409c4fd`.
Physical i386 compares the complete 131072-byte declared bank and source FP
status; Unicorn records ordered accesses. Full paths cover empty clumps,
multiple groups and actors, shared actor/group perception lists, query frees,
debug poisoning, occupancy retirement, allocation cursor and extent
contraction, matching/nonmatching references, unit attachments, active null
callbacks, and nonzero clump indices. The initial prefix fixture retains two
explicit typed service stops before the original indirect CALL. Its sibling
`native_campaign_ai_clump_retirement_callbacks_tu15.json` executes the four
actual callbacks through complete nonempty teardown, including matching and
nonmatching plan/behavior references and all callback orders. Read/store
fault prefixes compare exact partial state, including failures inside
callbacks and before reclamation is complete.

The fixture stores shared scenario inputs and original event streams once;
fault records retain the independently observed prefix hash, callback count
and FP status. The callback fixture's `complete_callbacks` flag identifies
whole callback execution; its inherited scope text also describes the
companion prefix mode of the same original-only capture tool.
No expected memory mutation or callback return is supplied to the original.
The real native ABI decodes the authored clump argument, retains the actual
caller return-word access and consumes the one callee argument. It does not
reconstruct dead volatile registers or private source stack frames.

Only the required JSON and compact proof reports are retained. Native GCC,
Clang and ASan/UBSan validation use the production CMake module. A compiled
private mutation drops the real occupancy retirement store, and a second
drops actual behavior invalidation; both must fail.
The original reference must regenerate byte for byte. Original executables,
raw banks, build products and mutants remain disposable. This component
proof covers the original registered nonempty invalidation closure. Complete
`ai_set_orders`, other behavior operations, and full campaign/runtime delivery
acceptance remain separate work. The shared generic free owner is
`native_tu15_data_array_delete`; the caller admits the original engine ABI's
forward string direction (`DF=0`) before invoking this semantic algorithm.
